es.L: Y en cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, la unción que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} permanece en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, y no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} necesidad de que nadie {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñe. Pero como {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} unción {{plural_you:les|os}} enseña acerca de todas las cosas, y es verdadera y no es mentira, y así como [la unción] {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: En cuanto a {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}} de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} una unción, y esa unción permanece en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}; no {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}} que nadie {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñe. Al contrario, {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} unción {{plural_you:les|os}} enseña acerca de todo, y es verdadera y no mentira. Así que, tal como la unción {{plural_you:les|os}} ha enseñado, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes recibieron|vosotros recibisteis}} de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} una unción, y esa unción permanece en {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Por eso no {{plural_you:necesitan|necesitáis}} que nadie {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñe. La unción que viene de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:les|os}} enseña acerca de todo. Esa enseñanza es verdadera, no es mentira. Así que {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, tal como se {{plural_you:les|os}} ha enseñado.

sw.L: Nanyi, upako mlioupokea kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} unakaa ndani yenu, wala hamna haja mtu yeyote awafundishe; lakini kama upako {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unavyowafundisha kuhusu mambo yote, nao ni kweli wala si uongo, na kama [upako huo] ulivyowafundisha, kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Kwa upande wenu, mlipokea upako kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, na upako huo unakaa ndani yenu; hamhitaji mtu yeyote awafundishe. Badala yake, upako {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} unawafundisha kuhusu kila kitu, nao ni kweli wala si uongo. Kwa hiyo, kama upako huo ulivyowafundisha, kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.R: Lakini ninyi mlipokea upako kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, na upako huo unakaa ndani yenu. Kwa hiyo hamhitaji mtu yeyote awafundishe. Upako unaotoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} unawafundisha kuhusu kila kitu. Mafundisho hayo ni kweli, si uongo. Basi kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kama mlivyofundishwa.

ko.L: 그리고 여러분은, 그분에게서 받은 기름 부음이 여러분 안에 머물러 있으니, 누가 여러분을 가르칠 필요가 없습니다. 오히려 그분의 기름 부음이 모든 것에 대하여 여러분을 가르치고, 그것은 참되고 거짓이 아니니, 그것이 여러분을 가르친 대로 그분 안에 머무르십시오.
ko.B: 여러분은 그분에게서 기름 부음을 받았고, 그 기름 부음이 여러분 안에 머물러 있습니다. 그래서 여러분은 누구에게 가르침을 받을 필요가 없습니다. 오히려 그분의 기름 부음이 모든 것에 대해 여러분을 가르치며, 그 가르침은 참되고 거짓이 아닙니다. 그러니 기름 부음이 여러분을 가르친 대로 그분 안에 머물러 있으십시오.
ko.R: 그러나 여러분은 그분에게서 기름 부음을 받았고, 그 기름 부음이 여러분 안에 머물러 있습니다. 그러니 여러분은 누구에게 가르침을 받을 필요가 없습니다. 그분에게서 온 기름 부음이 모든 것에 대해 여러분을 가르쳐 줍니다. 그 가르침은 참되고 거짓이 아닙니다. 그러니 여러분이 배운 대로 그분 안에 머물러 있으십시오.

vi.L: Còn các con, sự xức dầu mà các con đã nhận từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vẫn ở trong các con, và các con không cần ai dạy dỗ các con; nhưng như sự xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy dỗ các con về mọi điều, và là thật chứ không phải dối trá, và như [sự xức dầu ấy] đã dạy dỗ các con, hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Còn các con, các con đã nhận được sự xức dầu từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và sự xức dầu ấy ở trong các con; các con không cần ai dạy dỗ mình. Trái lại, sự xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy các con về mọi điều, và điều ấy là thật chứ không phải dối trá. Vậy như sự xức dầu đã dạy các con, hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nhưng các con đã được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} xức dầu, và sự xức dầu ấy ở trong các con. Vì vậy các con không cần ai dạy dỗ mình. Sự xức dầu đến từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} dạy các con về mọi điều. Lời dạy ấy là thật, không phải dối trá. Vậy hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như các con đã được dạy.

pt.L: E, quanto a vocês, a unção que receberam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} permanece em vocês, e vocês não têm necessidade de que alguém os ensine. Mas, como a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} unção os ensina a respeito de todas as coisas, e é verdadeira e não é mentira, e assim como [a unção] os ensinou, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.B: Quanto a vocês, receberam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} uma unção, e essa unção permanece em vocês; vocês não precisam que ninguém os ensine. Pelo contrário, a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} unção os ensina a respeito de tudo, e é verdadeira, não mentira. Por isso, assim como a unção os ensinou, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}.
pt.R: Mas vocês receberam {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} uma unção, e essa unção permanece em vocês. Por isso vocês não precisam que ninguém os ensine. A unção que vem {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} ensina vocês sobre tudo. Esse ensino é verdadeiro, não é mentira. Por isso, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, como vocês foram ensinados.

decisions.choice: and you: the sentence starts with "you", then makes the anointing the subject
decisions.reason: ὑμεῖς is set at the head for emphasis, as in 2:20 and 2:24, but the clause continues with the anointing as subject.

decisions.choice: the anointing: as in 2:20, most likely the Holy Spirit, given by Christ
alternatives: God's word, the message they heard
decisions.reason: What is said here, that it remains in them and teaches them about everything, Jesus says of the Spirit (John 14:16-17, 14:26). See the note on 2:20. "From him" is the Holy One of 2:20, here most likely Christ, who comes in 2:28.

decisions.choice: no need for anyone to teach you: no need of the new teaching the deceivers offer
alternatives: no need of any human teacher at all
decisions.reason: John himself is teaching them in this letter, so he does not mean that teachers are useless. He means they need no one to add to what the anointing has taught them, least of all the deceivers of 2:26.

decisions.choice: remain in him: a command
alternatives: you remain in him: a statement of fact
decisions.reason: μένετε has the same form in the present indicative and the imperative. 2:28 repeats it plainly as a command, "And now ... remain in him", which favors a command here too; read as a statement it would be a word of assurance.

decisions.choice: in him: in Christ
decisions.reason: αὐτῷ could be neuter and refer to the anointing, but 2:28 goes on with "remain in him ... when he appears", which is Christ.

decisions.choice: the long sentence leads up to its main verb, remain
decisions.reason: After "but as" the sentence piles up three clauses about the anointing before it reaches the command, "remain in him".

decisions.choice: [the anointing] taught (L); the anointing has taught (B); you have been taught (R)
decisions.reason: The anointing is most likely the Spirit (meaning decision m2), and the translation does not call the Spirit "it". English repeats "the anointing" or uses a passive instead.

decisions.choice: the long sentence broken into shorter ones
decisions.reason: Balanced uses three sentences and Readable five, with the command at the end as in the Greek.

decisions.choice: selon qu’elle vous a enseignés (L); comme elle vous l’a enseigné (B); comme vous l’avez appris (R)
decisions.reason: The English repeats "the anointing" so as not to call the Spirit "it" (m2). French has no neuter: "elle" simply refers back to the feminine noun "onction", as it would for any noun, so Literal and Balanced use it without saying anything about the Spirit. Readable uses an active "vous l’avez appris" for the English passive.

decisions.choice: "그분 안에 머무르십시오" (a command)
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads the last verb as a command and footnotes the reading as a statement; Korean must choose, and follows the meaning decision.

source.text: Καὶ νῦν, τεκνία, μένετε ἐν αὐτῷ, ἵνα ἐὰν φανερωθῇ σχῶμεν παρρησίαν καὶ μὴ αἰσχυνθῶμεν ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ αὐτοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: And now, little children, remain in him, so that if he is revealed we may have boldness and not be put to shame from him at the coming of him.

en.L: And now, little children, remain in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, so that when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears we may have boldness and not shrink in shame from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming.
en.B: And now, dear children, remain in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} appears, we will be able to face {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} boldly at {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} coming, instead of turning away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in shame.
en.R: And now, dear children, remain in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. Then, when {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes back and appears, we can stand before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} boldly. We will not have to turn away from {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in shame.

fr.L: Et maintenant, petits enfants, demeurez en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, afin que, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra, nous ayons de l’assurance et que nous ne nous détournions pas de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} dans la honte, à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue.
fr.B: Et maintenant, mes chers enfants, demeurez en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} paraîtra, nous pourrons nous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec assurance à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} venue, au lieu de nous détourner de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec honte.
fr.R: Et maintenant, mes chers enfants, demeurez en {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. Alors, quand {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} reviendra et se montrera, nous pourrons nous tenir devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec assurance. Nous n’aurons pas à nous détourner de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} avec honte.

es.L: Y ahora, hijitos, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, para que, cuando se manifieste, tengamos confianza y no nos apartemos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} avergonzados en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida.
es.B: Y ahora, hijitos, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Así, cuando se manifieste, podremos presentarnos ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} con confianza en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} venida, en lugar de apartarnos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} avergonzados.
es.R: Y ahora, hijos queridos, {{plural_you:permanezcan|permaneced}} en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Así, cuando vuelva y se manifieste, podremos estar delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sin miedo. No tendremos que apartarnos de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} avergonzados.

sw.L: Na sasa, watoto wadogo, kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, ili akidhihirishwa tuwe na uhuru, wala tusirudi nyuma mbali {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} kwa aibu wakati wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Na sasa, wanangu wapendwa, kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ndipo atakapodhihirishwa, tutaweza kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa ujasiri wakati wa kuja {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, badala ya kuficha nyuso zetu kwa aibu.
sw.R: Na sasa, wanangu wapendwa, kaeni ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Ndipo, atakaporudi na kuonekana, tutaweza kusimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} bila hofu. Hatutalazimika kuficha nyuso zetu mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa aibu.

ko.L: 그리고 이제, 어린 자녀 여러분, 그분 안에 머무르십시오. 그래서 그분이 나타나실 때에 우리가 담대함을 가지고, 그분이 오실 때에 그분 앞에서 부끄러워 물러서지 않게 하십시오.
ko.B: 그러니 이제, 어린 자녀 여러분, 그분 안에 머물러 있으십시오. 그러면 그분이 나타나실 때에 우리가 담대하게 그분을 맞이하고, 그분이 오실 때에 부끄러워 그분을 피하지 않게 될 것입니다.
ko.R: 그러니 이제, 사랑하는 자녀 여러분, 그분 안에 머물러 있으십시오. 그러면 그분이 다시 오셔서 나타나실 때, 우리는 담대하게 그분 앞에 설 수 있을 것입니다. 부끄러워서 그분을 피하지 않아도 될 것입니다.

vi.L: Và bây giờ, hỡi các con bé nhỏ, hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra, chúng ta được dạn dĩ và không bị hổ thẹn mà tránh xa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến.
vi.B: Và bây giờ, các con yêu dấu, hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Như vậy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hiện ra, chúng ta sẽ có thể dạn dĩ đối diện với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong lúc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến, thay vì hổ thẹn quay mặt tránh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Và bây giờ, các con yêu quý, hãy ở trong {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi khi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại và hiện ra, chúng ta có thể dạn dĩ đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Chúng ta sẽ không phải hổ thẹn quay mặt tránh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

pt.L: E agora, filhinhos, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}, para que, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} se manifestar, tenhamos confiança e não nos afastemos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} envergonhados na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vinda.
pt.B: E agora, filhinhos, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}. Assim, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} aparecer, poderemos estar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com confiança na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} vinda, em vez de nos afastarmos {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} envergonhados.
pt.R: E agora, queridos filhos, permaneçam {{deity_pronoun:nele|Nele}}. Assim, quando {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} voltar e aparecer, vamos poder ficar diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com confiança. Não vamos precisar nos afastar {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} com vergonha.

decisions.choice: when he appears: his appearing is certain; only its time is unknown
decisions.reason: ἐὰν can introduce something sure to happen whose time is not known (as in John 14:3). There is no doubt that he will appear.

decisions.choice: appears: Christ shown openly at his return
decisions.reason: φανερόω is used of his first coming in 1:2 and 3:5, and of his return here and in 3:2.

decisions.choice: boldness: the freedom of someone who can face the judge without fear
decisions.reason: παρρησία first meant freedom of speech. In this letter it is the confidence believers have before God (3:21; 5:14) and on the day of judgment (4:17).

decisions.choice: be ashamed before him: shrink away from him in shame
decisions.reason: With ἀπ the verb pictures drawing back from someone in disgrace.

decisions.choice: coming: Christ's arrival at the end of the age
decisions.reason: παρουσία means presence or arrival, and was used of a ruler's visit. It is the usual word for Christ's return (Matthew 24:3, 24:27; 1 Thessalonians 4:15), found only here in John's writings.

decisions.choice: we: John includes himself with his readers
alternatives: we, John and the other leaders, ashamed of those we taught
decisions.reason: He changes from "you" to "we". He may include himself as one who must also face Christ, or he may mean that he and the other leaders would be ashamed if their children fell away. The plain sense is the first.

decisions.choice: comes back and appears
decisions.reason: Readable says that the appearing is Christ's return (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: the purpose clause made a separate sentence
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence with "Then".

decisions.choice: de l’assurance, avec assurance; à sa venue
decisions.reason: "Assurance" says the freedom of one who can face the judge without fear (m3) and is used again in 3:21, 4:17 and 5:14. "Venue" is the plain word for Christ's coming (m5); "avènement" is now mostly said of a king's accession.

decisions.choice: confianza (L, B); sin miedo (R)
decisions.reason: As in 1 John 5:14, where the same word is "confianza" at Balanced and "sin miedo" at Readable. Here Literal also says "confianza", because the picture is facing a judge (meaning decision m3), not speaking freely in prayer. "Venida" for his coming, as in the other letters.

decisions.choice: uhuru (L); kwa ujasiri (B); bila hofu (R)
decisions.reason: As in 5:14: the word is the freedom of someone who can face the judge without fear (m3). Literal says "uhuru" (freedom), Balanced "ujasiri" (boldness), and Readable says what it means in practice, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: akidhihirishwa (L); atakapodhihirishwa (B); kuja kwake
decisions.reason: Christ shown openly at his return (m2): "kudhihirishwa" is the same verb used for the life that was revealed in 1:2. "Kuja" is the plain word for his coming (m5), as in the Gospels; Readable says "atakaporudi" (when he comes back), as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "나타나시다" for appear; "오실 때" for his coming; "담대함" for boldness
decisions.reason: Christ's appearing and coming are his return at the end (meaning decisions); Korean says it with the verb and the honorific, as in James 5:7 and 2 Peter 1:16. Boldness is the freedom of someone who can face the judge without fear (meaning decision), which "담대하다" says.

decisions.choice: "dạn dĩ" for boldness (also 3:21; 4:17; 5:14)
decisions.reason: Boldness is the freedom of someone who can face the judge without fear (m3). "Dạn dĩ" is the church word for this freedom before God; "tự tin" would make it self-confidence.

decisions.choice: confiança
decisions.reason: For the whole letter (3:21; 4:17; 5:14). The word is the freedom of someone who can face the judge without fear (meaning decision m3). Portuguese "ousadia" leans toward daring or even insolence; "confiança" says the calm assurance meant.

source.text: ἐὰν εἰδῆτε ὅτι δίκαιός ἐστιν, γινώσκετε ὅτι πᾶς ὁ ποιῶν τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἐξ αὐτοῦ γεγέννηται.

records.literal_gloss: If you know that righteous he is, you know that everyone the [one] doing the righteousness from him has been born.

en.L: If you know that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is righteous, you know that everyone who does righteousness has been born of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Since you know that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is righteous, you can be sure that everyone who does what is righteous has been born of {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.R: You know that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is righteous. So you can also be sure that everyone who does what is right has been born of God.

fr.L: Si vous savez qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est juste, vous savez que quiconque pratique la justice est né de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.B: Puisque vous savez qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est juste, vous pouvez être sûrs que quiconque fait ce qui est juste est né de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.
fr.R: Vous savez qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est juste. Alors vous pouvez être sûrs aussi que celui qui fait ce qui est bien est né de Dieu.

es.L: Si {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es justo, {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que todo el que practica la justicia ha nacido de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.B: Puesto que {{plural_you:saben|sabéis}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es justo, {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de que todo el que hace lo que es justo ha nacido de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Ustedes saben|Vosotros sabéis}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es justo. Así que también {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} estar seguros de que todo el que hace lo que es justo ha nacido de Dios.

sw.L: Ikiwa mnajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwenye haki, mnajua kwamba kila anayetenda haki amezaliwa kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.
sw.B: Kwa kuwa mnajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwenye haki, mnaweza kuwa na hakika kwamba kila anayetenda yaliyo ya haki amezaliwa {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}}.
sw.R: Mnajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ni mwenye haki. Kwa hiyo mnaweza pia kuwa na hakika kwamba kila anayetenda haki amezaliwa na Mungu.

ko.L: 여러분이 그분께서 의로우시다는 것을 알면, 의를 행하는 사람은 모두 그분에게서 났다는 것도 압니다.
ko.B: 여러분은 그분께서 의로우시다는 것을 알고 있으니, 의를 행하는 사람은 모두 그분에게서 태어났다는 것도 분명히 알 수 있습니다.
ko.R: 여러분은 그분께서 의로우시다는 것을 압니다. 그러니 옳은 일을 하는 사람은 모두 하나님에게서 태어났다는 것도 확신할 수 있습니다.

vi.L: Nếu các con biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là công chính, thì các con biết rằng mọi người làm điều công chính đều đã được sinh ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì các con biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là công chính, các con có thể chắc rằng mọi người làm điều công chính đều đã được sinh ra từ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Các con biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là công chính. Vậy các con cũng có thể chắc rằng ai làm điều ngay thẳng thì đã được Đức Chúa Trời sinh ra.

pt.L: Se vocês sabem que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é justo, sabem que todo aquele que pratica a justiça nasceu {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.B: Uma vez que vocês sabem que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é justo, podem ter certeza de que todo aquele que faz o que é justo nasceu {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}.
pt.R: Vocês sabem que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é justo. Então também podem ter certeza de que todo aquele que faz o que é certo nasceu de Deus.

decisions.choice: if you know: a premise the readers accept, so "since you know"
decisions.reason: ἐὰν here does not express doubt; John is building on what they already know.

decisions.choice: you know: a statement
decisions.reason: γινώσκετε could be an indicative or an imperative. The statement fits the reasoning best: if you know this, you also know that.

decisions.choice: he is righteous: probably Christ; born of him: God
decisions.reason: The nearest person is Christ (2:28), and he is called righteous in 2:1 and 3:7. But John never speaks of being born of Christ; every other time it is born of God (3:9; 4:7; 5:1, 5:4, 5:18; John 1:13), and 3:1 goes straight on to "children of God". John may move from Son to Father without marking it, or he may mean God throughout (God is called righteous in 1:9).

decisions.choice: doing what is righteous shows that a person has been born of God
alternatives: doing right is how one becomes born of God
decisions.reason: The perfect γεγέννηται puts the birth first; the doing of right, a continuing way of life (present tense), is the evidence of it, not the cause. This is the first mention of new birth in the letter.

decisions.choice: does what is righteous (B); does what is right (R)
decisions.reason: "Does righteousness" is not natural English. Balanced keeps the key term as "righteous"; Readable says "right", the everyday word for the same thing.

decisions.choice: born of God
decisions.reason: Readable names God, following meaning decision m3; Literal and Balanced keep "him".

decisions.choice: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}; {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}
decisions.reason: Pronouns for God or Christ take the deity_pronoun setting.

decisions.choice: pratique la justice (L); fait ce qui est juste (B); fait ce qui est bien (R) (for the whole book)
decisions.reason: "Faire la justice" would suggest administering justice. Literal keeps the noun "justice" of the term sheet with "pratiquer"; Balanced keeps the key word as "juste", and Readable uses the everyday "bien", as the English Readable says "right". Literal and Balanced say the same in 3:7 and 3:10, where Readable follows the English "live a righteous life" ("vivre d’une manière juste").

decisions.choice: kutenda haki; amezaliwa kutoka kwake (L), amezaliwa naye (B), amezaliwa na Mungu (R)
decisions.reason: "Haki" is the key word for righteousness, so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "what is right" (m4). As in 5:1, Literal keeps the Greek "from" with "kutoka kwake", and Balanced and Readable use the passive with "na", the ordinary way to name who gave birth.

decisions.choice: "그분" for both "he is righteous" and "born of him"; "하나님" (R) for the second
decisions.reason: The meaning decision reads "he is righteous" as probably Christ and "born of him" as God, and footnotes it. Korean "그분" with the honorific can mean either, as the Greek does; Readable names God for the second, as the English Readable does. "났다" (L) and "태어났다" (B, R) for being born of God, as in the Korean John 1:13.

decisions.choice: "được sinh ra từ" (L, B), "được Đức Chúa Trời sinh ra" (R) for born of him, through the letter
decisions.reason: Being born of God is the new life God gives (m4). "Sinh ra từ" keeps the source plain; "tái sinh" is kept for 1 Peter's "born again", a different word.
